desc:
This is the true TZR supported by its original developers since 2021, and since the hack. 

TZR is a wave defense combining shooter and hack-and-slash elements, and character progression through customizable perks and equipment. Fight through the Deluge campaign, earn weapons and upgrades through achievements and story completion, and enhance your capabilities with experimental cybernetic augmentations. Stand alongside your comrades, hold the line against overwhelming enemy forces, and prove your worth to the Empire.

+50% XP & Tokens on weekends
Premium: -5% XP Requirement.
